entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: An epidural blood patch (EBP) is a surgical procedure that uses autologous blood, meaning the patient's own blood, in order to close one or many holes in the dura mater of the spinal cord, which occurred as a complication of a lumbar puncture or epidural placement. The punctured dura causes cerebrospinal fluid leak. The procedure can be used to relieve orthostatic headaches, most commonly post dural puncture headache (PDPH).
